Customer contacted the call center to inform that she is not feeling the effects of the drug. I explain that in this case, there is a process called Pharmacovigilance, whereby every pharmaceutical company needs to report any event to the health authorities, in order to guarantee the safety of the product. Therefore, it will be necessary to carry out a questionnaire about her treatment. Customer agrees. During the questionnaire, she informs that she uses the drug from Monday to Friday, which started in 2010, but she took some breaks on her own, or because of the value, returning to take it for approximately 1 year without taking breaks. Thank her for the information and request the photos. I explain that considering the data provided by her, there is a use of the product outside of what is established in the package insert. It is important to inform that the package insert indications are based on clinical studies and approved by ANVISA, thus, for use only from Monday to Friday informed by her, there are no clinical studies that guarantee both the efficacy and safety of the product. Thus, we advise that the prescribing physician be consulted to assess the treatment and necessary adjustments. In this case, we can collect the product for analysis, but we will not proceed with the immediate reimbursement of the product. Reimbursement will only be made if there is any deviation in the quality of the product, that is, after collection of the product and completion of the analyses. The client asks if just because she doesn't take the drug on the weekend, on other days it has no effect, and before she took the 50mg one and felt the effects, but with this 70mg one, she felt absolutely nothing. She searched the internet and saw other complaints about it, before she thought it was a problem with her, but after she researched she learned that other people are also not feeling the effects of the 70mg drug, and there was even a counterfeit batch. Regarding forgery, I explain about the resolution and revocation. I would like to clarify that, like her case, we have received reports from other consumers reporting alleged ineffectiveness of the Venvanse® product and has been acting promptly, assisting patients who contact us, collecting the claimed products and sending them for evaluation by the technical area, as well as compensating when applicable. It is also important to inform that the batches for which we have received complaints have gone through an extensive battery of analysis, from the production of raw materials, manufacturing, transport, storage and distribution chain and we can guarantee that the batches have been released to the marketing chain in full compliance with the specifications. It is also worth emphasizing that there was no change in the drug formula or in the Venvanse® production process that could result in the product's ineffectiveness. Customer informs that she will save the remaining cps for us to do the analysis, because there is certainly something different. I clarify that when we collect a vial and submit it for analysis by our Quality Control Laboratory, the vials are opened and the capsules handled. Therefore, even in accordance with the quality specifications and without identified market deviation, we cannot return the collected product to the patient. Customer agrees, therefore, I inform the Capital's collection procedure, making it clear that it needs to have cps in the bottle to be collected. I collect the necessary data and inform the deadline of 60 working days for analysis. I question if there was any doubt, as no, contact is closed.

中北薬品で原薬の秤量中にコデインリン酸塩水和物（ 1 kg 包装）の内容量が管理基準を超えているものが発見された（ 別紙「秤量記録」）。

中北薬品では製剤１ ロットで1 kg 包装×5 袋の5,000ｇ を秤量し、家庭麻薬となるよう乳糖で1000 分の10 に倍散している。この度小数点第2 位まで測れる秤量器に更新したことにより秤量範囲を見直していた。
原薬5,000ｇ の秤量範囲は武田の管理基準の+0.2g×5 である+1.0g とし、1 kg 包装品は１ 袋ずつ全量投入しているため、+1.0g を超える場合は乳糖追加投入で中北薬品では逸脱措置の対応となるとの事。

今後中北薬品で製造で標準的仕込み量を見直すか検討するにあたり、武田及び中北薬品での充填量管理の実態と両社での相違、当該原因調査について調査実施を依頼された。
